digest.component_or_area: bridge reconciler, store mapping, multi-project inbound fetch and outbound dispatch
propositions: Bridge is hard-wired to one tracker project at three independent points: JiraConfig.project scalar, inbound fetcher JQL pair, and outbound applier CrossProjectTargetError guard

Multiple repos or tracker projects against one shared ticket store must record project and repos membership per ticket using tri-state fields (absent=legacy, empty=never sync, explicit key=sync there)
Store-level project mapping at .bridge_state/projects.json owns the project set to prevent multi-pass diff collisions when different repos fetch different project subsets
Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate configured projects for JQL pairs and enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink), merging results keyed by issue into shared snapshot
Outbound dispatch per-ticket project on create with guard relaxed from single project to set membership, and tickets with explicitly empty project produce no mutation

Pre-feature stores migrate with zero events written by resolving absent project against legacy default via idempotent ensure unit, and multi-project stores carry multi-project-bridge capability stamp that causes fail-closed on older binaries
